# The Bridal Desk

> Bridal coordination and wedding-day operations for Nigerian brides.

The Bridal Desk is a bridal operations company founded by Desire Cole that helps Nigerian brides experience calm, coordinated, stress-free weddings. The company provides professional wedding coordination services in Lagos and Southwest Nigeria.

## Services

- **Day-of Coordination**: Professional execution on the wedding day for brides who have handled their own planning.
- **Full Wedding Planning**: End-to-end planning support from concept through final-day delivery.
- **Bridal Concierge**: Personal support for the bride throughout the wedding journey.
- **Vendor Coordination**: Communication, reminders, and wedding-day alignment across all vendor teams.
- **Emergency Support**: Prepared kits, backup contacts, and practical wedding-day problem solving.

## The Bridal Command Center

A six-desk operational system covering: Timeline Desk, Vendor Desk, Bride Concierge, People Desk, Emergency Desk, and Partner Desk.

## The Bridal Room

A bridal preparation masterclass covering: wedding budgeting, vendor selection, morning timelines, emergency kits, food safety, and mental preparation.

## Partnerships

The Bridal Desk works with brands through sponsorships, partnerships, and vendor relationships.

## Location

Lagos and Southwest Nigeria. Available for multi-day celebrations.

## Contact

Book a consultation via the inquiry form at https://thebridaldesk.com/#inquiry
